name: Master Components Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, Master Components Ltd is in the business of manufacturing of  Plastic Engineering Components and sub assemblies[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MCL is an IATF 16949:2016 & ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of plastic engineering components and sub-assemblies. It excels in Thermoplastic Injection Moulding, Thermoset Injection Moulding, and Transfer Moulding & Compression Moulding

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 25.2% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 73.4 days to 52.9 days
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -5.58%
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.38 Cr.
